en.headline: Customs seize cocaine and cannabis worth HK$6.8 million at airport, arrest two
en.dek: Officers found about 5.4 kilograms of suspected cocaine and 17 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds in the luggage of two mainland passengers arriving on consecutive days.
body: Hong Kong Customs detected two drug trafficking cases involving incoming passengers at Hong Kong International Airport on 17 and 18 October, seizing suspected cocaine, cannabis buds and alprazolam tablets with a total estimated market value of about HK$6.8 million.

In the first case, a 40-year-old mainland man arrived from São Paulo, Brazil, via Istanbul on 17 October. During clearance, officers found about 5.4 kilograms of suspected cocaine, valued at around HK$3.3 million, inside his carry-on baggage and arrested him.

In the second case, a 52-year-old mainland woman arrived from Bangkok, Thailand, on 18 October. Officers discovered about 17 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds, valued at around HK$3.5 million, in her checked luggage and 15 suspected alprazolam tablets in her backpack. She was arrested.

Customs said it would continue to strengthen enforcement against drug trafficking through intelligence analysis and risk-based selection of passengers from high-risk regions. Trafficking in a dangerous drug carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲約680萬元可卡因及大麻花 拘兩名內地旅客
zh.dek: 關員在連續兩日抵港的兩名內地旅客行李內，分別發現約5.4公斤懷疑可卡因及約17公斤懷疑大麻花。
body: 香港海關在10月17日及18日於香港國際機場偵破兩宗入境旅客販運毒品案件，共檢獲懷疑可卡因、大麻花及阿普唑営，估計市值共約680萬元。
首宗案件中，一名40歲內地男旅客於17日從巴西聖保羅經土耳其伊斯坦堡飛抵本港。海關人員清關時，在其手提行李內發現約5.4公斤、估計市值約330萬元的懷疑可卡因，遂把他拘捕。
第二宗案件中，一名52歲內地女旅客於18日從泰國曼谷飛抵本港。關員在其寄倉行李中發現約17公斤、估計市值約350萬元的懷疑大麻花，並在其隨身背包內檢獲15粒懷疑阿普唑営，隨即將她拘捕。
海關表示會繼續根據情報分析加強打擊販毒活動，並按風險管理原則重點揀選來自高風險地區的旅客作清關檢查。根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物屬嚴重罪行，一經定罪，最高可被判罰款500萬元及終身監禁。
